parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID (aliased compound_chembl_id), canonical SMILES, compound key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback doi), assay description (aliased assay_description from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target ChEMBL ID (aliased target_chembl_id from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target name (aliased target_name from target_dictionary.pref_name), and target organism (aliased target_organism from target_dictionary.organism). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to compound_records on record_id, compound_records to docs on doc_id, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL220', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and docs.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL or docs.doi IS NOT NULL. For pubmed_id_or_doi, prefer docs.pubmed_id when non-null, otherwise use docs.doi. Do not deduplicate; preserve all qualifying activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
